segments.description: Close up shots of makeup brushes and clothes being packed in a suitcase.
Text overlay introducing the weekend vlog topics over footage of packing.
A person making a bed, smoothing sheets and arranging pillows.
Preparing a drink in a pink bottle.
Packing items into a colourful tote bag in the kitchen.
A woman putting clothes into a washing machine in a laundry room.
Time-lapse of the woman vacuuming the living room sofa and rug.
Time-lapse of the woman cleaning the kitchen island counter.
A young boy vacuuming a bedroom and gesturing to the camera.
The woman talking to the camera in her living room about her plans for the weekend vlog.
An image of a historic building decorated with festive lights.
The woman continues talking to the camera, looking up Sovereign Hill information on her phone.
A young boy demonstrating his moonwalk in the living room.
Going outside to pet and say goodbye to a dog in a kennel.
Food footage at McDonald's drive-thru, including fries placed inside a burger.
Driving on the highway under cloudy skies.
Arriving at the holiday park, driving past small cabins.
Entering and showing the interior of the cabin, including living area and bedrooms.
The woman giving a tour of the cabin and chatting with her kids in the bedroom.
The woman talking about the weather and travel experience inside the cabin.
Exploring details of the cabin, including a vintage built-in radio unit.
Walking outside the cabin and visiting another family member's cabin unit.
Exploring holiday park amenities: arcade room, playground, and outdoor pool area with ducks.
The woman walking outside with her daughter talking about dinner plans.
Looking through the cabin window at her son.
The woman showing her outfit in the mirror before going out for dinner.
Golden City Hotel exterior, interior restaurant view, menu, and meal served.
Ending slide with text thanking viewers on top of the food photo.
Final graphic screen with family photo and social media links.

hook.opening_visual: Close-up shot of makeup brushes in a holder, followed by packing shots.
hook.notes: Starts with a montage of cleaning and packing activities.

cta_moments.text: I'll add a card to that one
